summary: Tested admin dashboard restructure from dropdown groups to separate pages with tile navigation. Found and fixed critical bug: TrainingSection and AIAssistant components were not imported. All 8 tiles now navigate correctly to their respective pages with Back button functionality.

issues: Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - minor React hydration warning in year selector dropdown (pre-existing)

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Missing imports for TrainingSection and AIAssistant components in AdminDashboard.jsx - caused app crash when clicking Training tile
AdminDashboard.jsx line 394: activePage state controls page navigation ('home', 'team', 'payroll', 'operations', 'forms', 'hiring', 'messages', 'training', 'ai')
AdminDashboard.jsx lines 3610-3636: Tile grid with 8 navigation tiles using data-testid='nav-tile-{id}' pattern
AdminDashboard.jsx lines 3567-3575: Back button with data-testid='admin-back-btn' returns to home page
Home page correctly shows: All Employees section, Hours by Employee section, and 8 navigation tiles
Team page shows: All Employees, Hours by Employee, Password Management, Employee Terminations
Payroll page shows: Payroll summary cards, PayrollHistorySection, PaymentRecordsSection
Operations page shows: GPS Mileage Tracker, Pull List, Sales Data, Taxes, Tax Returns Archive
Forms page shows: Form Submissions section
Hiring page shows: All Applications, Send Application Link, Pending Documents, Applicant Tests, Interview Scheduler
Training page shows: Employee Training with 6 modules
AI Assistant page shows: AI Assistant component
